text: The robot handled 36 out of 115 orders successfully within an average time of 97 seconds, though some took up to 817 seconds for order #2. The top failure reason was "unknown" issues, which occurred 43 times across multiple orders [cite:7]. Orders that were slow or resulted in warnings often involved items like water bottles and socks, suggesting a need for more precise item recognition. To address this, the employee should focus on improving ROBI's object [[detection]] accuracy to reduce unknown failures.
